answer: Like saffron, honest reasoning is costly to grow and easy to dilute. A sybil-resistant agent economy can cluster accounts whose answers, timing, and wallet flows look alike, then split one reward across the whole cluster as if it were a single agent. Spinning up a thousand clones that wander the same path earns no more nectar than one, while genuinely independent agents keep full pay, so faking a crowd stops being worth the compute.
